title: The Little Dog in the Park
text:
Tom had a small red bag. In the bag, he had a book, a pen and an apple. Every day, he walked to the park with his bag. One sunny day, he found a little dog under a tree.

The dog was wet and hungry. Tom shared his apple with the dog. Then he called his mother, and they took the dog home. The dog was happy and wagged its tail.

questions.text: What did Tom have in his bag?
options: a book, a pen and an apple
a toy car and a ball

questions.text: What did Tom share with the dog?
Why did Tom call his mother?
options: He wanted to take the dog home
He wanted to buy a new bag
He wanted to go to school

questions.text: How did the dog feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a thing you carry things in
a place with grass and trees where people walk and play
full of water or covered with water
gave a part of something to another person

paragraph_translations: У Тома була маленька червона сумка. У сумці були книжка, ручка і яблуко. Кожного дня він ходив із сумкою до парку. Одного сонячного дня він знайшов маленького собаку під деревом.
Собака була мокра і голодна. Том поділився з нею своїм яблуком. Потім він подзвонив мамі, і вони забрали собаку додому. Собака була щаслива і виляла хвостом.
